name: 765874: Unification
overview:
765874: Unification is a four-part speculative science-fiction drama set in a near future fractured by environmental collapse, political instability, and accelerating technology. At its center is Project 765874, a classified initiative designed to unify global systems and decision-making to prevent human extinction.

As the project moves from theory to deployment, engineers, officials, and civilians confront its hidden costs. While the system can predict conflict and enforce stability, it also erodes autonomy, blurring the line between order and control. With loyalties fractured and consequences escalating, the final episode asks whether humanity can survive unity if freedom itself is the price.
